svg.title: NET-06 — Compact final scoreboard, network role variants
svg.desc: 1280 by 900 client. A short completed network result uses Local Play's display-name column followed by K, A, D, K/D and PTS. Network identity, rank and additional statistics remain accessible in supporting result and round detail through existing navigation, without enlarging the primary table. Host actions are shown; Guest substitutes its existing Leave and waiting text. There is no large final window, new control or fixed diagnostic-style outcome hierarchy.

g.text: Not saved to local statistics or Elo
ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Local Play names and K/A/D/K/D/PTS; primary width/height follow score content, not supporting detail.
Identity/owner/rank and other statistics remain in existing 16 px result/round detail, associated with each player and scope.
One strip; per-round score tables reuse the five columns at 32 px. Existing navigation/feedback exposes actual overflow only.
Guest: replace Host actions with centered Leave; add Waiting for host to return to lobby or end session above status lines.
Status/actions are actual network additions, not blank local reservations. Footer gaps, counter and notice follow the appearance owner.
Names remain neutral white; values/pipes yellow, Team fills and grouping unchanged. New pointer bounds must match moved controls.
